title: Smart people in tech and business react to Google's leadership changes
excerpt: Opinions diverge on what it means for DeepMind's future as Google makes big changes to its AI leadership.
content_html:
What smart people in tech are saying about Google's AI leadership overhaul

By Katherine Li

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

and Shubhangi Goel

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Google is overhauling its AI leadership.

CEO Sundar Pichai said in a post on Wednesday that DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis will step down from the role to become Alphabet's chief scientist, focusing on long-term AI research. Google veteran Jeff Dean is also leaving to launch a new startup with fellow engineering leader Sanjay Ghemawat.

In an X post on Wednesday, Dean launched Discover Loop and said that it is a public benefit corporation "whose mission is to automate machine learning, science, and engineering to accelerate discoveries and progress."

The shake-up comes as Google faces mounting pressure from competitors like OpenAI and Anthropic in key areas such as AI coding. Alphabet shares fell as much as 5% following the announcement.

Here is what the smartest voices in business and tech are saying about Google's AI executive shake-up.

Sebastian Mallaby, author of 'The Infinity Machine: Demis Hassabis, DeepMind, and the Quest for Superintelligence'

Sebastian Mallaby, a British journalist and author who once wrote a biography of Hassabis and DeepMind, said in a on X that the change is "a formalization of something that had been happening informally."

"Demis has been playing the role of Google AI statesman for some time, and Koray Kavukcuoglu has been running Google DeepMind research for some time," Mallaby said.

"He cared enough about safety that he fought a three-year battle with Alphabet to get external oversight over DeepMind's AI deployment," Mallaby added of Hassabis. "This next chapter of his career is a return to that side of his work."

Vinod Khosla, entrepreneur and venture capitalist

Vinod Khosla, a billionaire entrepreneur and a cofounder of Sun Microsystems, wrote in a post on X that Google has been "the real source of AI acceleration," from developing Waymo cars when most people were skeptics to investing heavily in AI.

"Lots of research in universities but this team, including Sundar, Larry & Sergey, deserve full credit for believing, investing and accelerating it," said Khosla on Wednesday. "Huge impact."

Everett Butler, head of marketing at Emergent

Butler, who heads global marketing at the $1.5 billion vibe-coding startup, called the leadership shake-up a big deal.

"Four AI legends just left Google to start a company that will eventually be worth more than OpenAI and Anthropic combined," he wrote on LinkedIn on Wednesday.

He added that their new venture, Discovery Loop, could radically change how tech breakthroughs happen.

"AI has mostly helped humans do research. Discovery Loop wants AI to be the researcher: form hypotheses, run experiments, learn from the results, and keep going," he wrote. "Alphabet fell over 5% after the news. Their work helped build Google. Discovery Loop will be their most consequential creation yet."

Ben Pouladian, founder of BEP Research

Pouladian, the founder of BEP Research, an AI infrastructure research firm, said that the change in structure means that Google "finally wants to play to win."

"My read: putting Amin Vahdat, the architect behind Google's TPU infrastructure, closer to the center is about streamlining the whole machine," Pouladian wrote on X on Wednesday.

"Less internal politics. Better compute allocation. One AI strategy," Pouladian added.

Zvi Mowshowitz, writer and founder of Balsa Research

Zvi Mowshowitz, founder of Balsa Research, an AI policy research agency, said on X on Wednesday that Google's shift doesn't bode well for AI safety.

"Big moves at Google DeepMind," Mowshowitz said. "Early read is this is Demis being 'kicked upstairs' and allowed to work on his special projects. Also Jeff Dean is stepping away."

"Presumably this puts the final nail in the coffin of 'DeepMind has meaningful safety practices, assurances or independence from the rest of Google,'" Mowshowitz added.

Tae Kim, veteran tech journalist and author of First Adopter

Tae Kim, a veteran tech journalist and author of the bestselling AI and semiconductor newsletter First Adopter, said it may be "Game over" for DeepMind.

"Jeff Dean and Demis Hassabis are the two most important AI executives at Google," said Kim in a post on X on Wednesday. "Jeff is leaving and Demis is stepping down from day-to-day operational leadership at DeepMind."

Jiang Liu, Chinese tech analyst and cofounder of Turing Company

Liu, an AI analyst based in Beijing, wrote on X that the move is Google's way of consolidating its AI operations.

"Google is streamlining its elite troops here, cutting down on redundancies," Liu wrote on Wednesday. "Koray was already the main force leading the team in getting things done, and now they're reducing reporting layers while concentrating all resources on him."

On Thursday, Liu also reacted to Semafor reporting that Hassabis has begun shifting away from his CEO duties over the last year.

Liu wrote that this was "actually a good thing."

"He actually understands AI4Science better and not so much large models. Meanwhile, Jeff Dean is more of an underlying tech expert (Infra), and he doesn't actually manage that many people," he said. "The two of them were originally more suited to roles focused on external communications."

Gergely Orosz, writer of the Pragmatic Engineer newsletter

In a post on X, the tech newsletter writer said that Dean and Ghemawat's new venture is probably the biggest startup announcement of the year and perhaps the decade because of who the founders are.

"If I had to name the top 10 engineers currently or previously at Google in terms of impact it would be the two cofounders (Larry and Sergey) and all 4 of these folks," he wrote.

科技界的聪明人对谷歌人工智能领导力改革的看法

作者：Katherine Li 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 和 Shubhangi Goel 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

谷歌正在彻底改变其人工智能领导地位。

首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)周三在一篇帖子中表示，DeepMind首席执行官德米斯·哈萨比斯(Demis Hassabis)将辞去这一职务，出任Alphabet首席科学家，专注于长期人工智能研究。 谷歌资深人士 Jeff Dean 也将离职，与工程领导者 Sanjay Ghemawat 一起创办一家新的初创公司。

在周三的 X 帖子中，Dean 推出了 Discover Loop，并表示这是一家公益公司，“其使命是实现机器学习、科学和工程自动化，以加速发现和进步。”

这次重组正值谷歌在人工智能编码等关键领域面临来自 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等竞争对手越来越大的压力之际。 消息公布后，Alphabet 股价下跌 5%。

以下是商界和科技界最聪明的声音对谷歌人工智能高管改组的看法。

Sebastian Mallaby，《无限机器：Demis Hassabis、DeepMind 和超级智能的探索》一书的作者

英国记者兼作家塞巴斯蒂安·马拉比（Sebastian Mallaby）曾为哈萨比斯和 DeepMind 写过传记，他在 on X 上表示，这一变化是“对非正式发生的事情的正式化”。

“Demis 扮演谷歌 AI 政治家的角色已经有一段时间了，而 Koray Kavukcuoglu 一直在运行 Google DeepMind 研究，”Mallaby 说。

“他非常关心安全，因此与 Alphabet 进行了长达三年的斗争，以获得对 DeepMind 人工智能部署的外部监督，”马拉比在谈到哈萨比斯时补充道。 “他职业生涯的下一个篇章是回归他工作的这一面。”

Vinod Khosla，企业家和风险投资家

亿万富翁企业家、Sun Microsystems 联合创始人维诺德·科斯拉 (Vinod Khosla) 在 X 上的一篇文章中写道，从大多数人持怀疑态度时开发 Waymo 汽车到大力投资人工智能，谷歌一直是“人工智能加速的真正源泉”。

科斯拉周三表示：“大学里进行了大量研究，但包括桑达尔、拉里和谢尔盖在内的这个团队相信、投资并加速了研究，值得充分赞扬。” “影响巨大。”

Everett Butler，Emergent 营销主管

巴特勒是这家价值 15 亿美元的振动编码初创公司的全球营销负责人，他称这次领导层变动是一件大事。

“四位人工智能传奇人物刚刚离开谷歌，创办了一家公司，其价值最终将超过 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的总和，”他周三在 LinkedIn 上写道。

他补充说，他们的新企业 Discovery Loop 可能会从根本上改变技术突破的发生方式。

“人工智能主要帮助人类进行研究。 Discovery Loop 希望人工智能成为研究者：形成假设、进行实验、从结果中学习并继续前进，”他写道。 “消息传出后，Alphabet 股价下跌超过 5%。 他们的工作帮助建立了谷歌。 Discovery Loop 将是他们迄今为止最重要的创造。”

Ben Pouladian，BEP 研究创始人

AI基础设施研究公司BEP Research的创始人Pouladian表示，结构的变化意味着谷歌“终于想赢了”。

Pouladian 周三在 X 上写道：“我的理解是：将谷歌 TPU 基础设施背后的架构师 Amin Vahdat 放在更靠近中心的位置是为了简化整个机器。”

“减少内部政治。 更好的计算分配。 一种人工智能策略，”Pouladian 补充道。

Zvi Mowshowitz，作家兼 Balsa Research 创始人

人工智能政策研究机构 Balsa Research 的创始人 Zvi Mowshowitz 周三在 X 上表示，谷歌的转变对于人工智能安全来说并不是好兆头。

“谷歌 DeepMind 的重大举措，”莫肖维茨说。 “早期读到的是，这是杰米斯被‘踢上楼’并被允许从事他的特殊项目。 杰夫·迪恩也将离开。”

Mowshowitz 补充道：“想必这为‘DeepMind 拥有有意义的安全实践、保证或独立于谷歌其他部门’的棺材敲下了最后的钉子。”

Tae Kim，资深科技记者和《First Adopter》作者

资深科技记者、畅销人工智能和半导体通讯《First Adopter》的作者 Tae Kim 表示，对于 DeepMind 来说，这可能是“游戏结束了”。

“杰夫·迪恩和德米斯·哈萨比斯是谷歌两位最重要的人工智能高管，”金周三在 X 上发帖表示。 “杰夫将离开，戴米斯将辞去 DeepMind 的日常运营领导职务。”

刘江，中国科技分析师、图灵公司联合创始人

北京的人工智能分析师刘在 X 上写道，此举是谷歌巩固其人工智能业务的一种方式。

“谷歌正在精简这里的精锐部队，减少裁员，”刘周三写道。 “科雷已经是带领团队完成任务的主力，现在他们正在减少汇报层级，将所有资源集中在他身上。”

周四，刘还对 Semafor 报道做出回应，称哈萨比斯在去年开始辞去首席执行官职务。

刘写道，这“实际上是一件好事”。

“他实际上更了解 AI4Science，而不是大型模型。 与此同时，杰夫·迪恩更像是一位底层技术专家（Infra），他实际上并没有管理那么多人，”他说。 “他们两个原本更适合专注于对外沟通的角色。”

Gergely Orosz，实用工程师通讯作者

这位科技通讯作者在 X 上的一篇文章中表示，迪恩和格玛瓦特的新企业可能是今年乃至十年来最大的初创企业公告，因为创始人是谁。

他写道：“如果我必须按影响力来列出当前或以前在 Google 的 10 名工程师，那么我的选择是两位联合创始人（拉里和谢尔盖）以及所有这 4 个人。”
